added.long_description:
ernd is the card for companies that pay for AI, offering up to 6% back on AI spend and 2% on everything else. We pool startups’ purchasing power to negotiate discounts, higher usage limits and priority support from AI providers. We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions.

long_description.before:
Starcloud is building data centers in space, initially to provide GPU compute to other satellites, and later to address the rapidly growing demand for energy caused by the deployment of AI. Falling launch costs give Starcloud access to abundant energy, radiative cooling, and the ability to rapidly scale in space.

In November 2025, just 21 months after founding, Starcloud launched its first satellite, Starcloud-1 to space. This has an Nvidia H100, which is 100x more powerful GPU than has ever been operated in space before. With this, they became the first entity to train an LLM in space and the first to run a version of Gemini in space. Starcloud will soon also run high-powered inference on Capella SAR data on orbit for the first time. 

Starcloud is launching its second satellite in October 2026, which will have 100x the power generation of the first and generate more cash than it costs to build and launch. Starcloud expects that within 10 years, most new data centers will be being built in space for the energy.

In March 2026, Starcloud raised a $170M Series A led by Benchmark, becoming the fastest unicorn in YC history, just 17 months after demo day.

long_description.before:
.Wave builds a continuous inference engine for streaming AI models, including full-duplex voice and streaming speech recognition.   

Customers bring their models; we integrate and run them, managing execution, session state, and scheduling to reduce end-to-end latency and serving cost per live session.  

We use cadenced inference to support more concurrent sessions per GPU while keeping latency low and consistent.
long_description.after:
.Wave provides dedicated inference capacity for real-time workloads, alongside serverless streaming models for speech and conversation.

Our Dedicated Lanes give you the guarantees of a dedicated endpoint (latency, capacity, locked-in price) without paying for idle GPUs. Capacity is matched to your traffic on an agreed schedule: more during peak hours, less during quieter periods, or none when you don’t need service. You only pay for the capacity and time windows you reserve.

Our .wave Live API, powered by our WPK inference engine, provides streaming speech recognition and full-duplex voice.

one_liner.before: Continuous inference for streaming AI models

long_description.before:
Turnstone is the AI workspace where your agents already know you. Connect your apps (e.g. email, calendar, Slack, Drive) and your local folders. Turnstone turns all of it into your second brain and continuously updates it.

Spin up agents (e.g. chief of staff, research, GTM) that all share that brain, so you stop re-explaining yourself and start getting real work done.

It all lives on your machine and runs on any model you already pay for. Ask your agent once, and it's done.
long_description.after:
**Turnstone is the best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative. Run persistent Agents on your Mac with the AI subscriptions or API keys you already have.**

On Turnstone, you can connect multiple AI subscriptions / API keys in one place, and build a team of agents just like you would on Grokbot. 

When a subscription runs out, your Agent can automatically move to another connected subscription with available capacity. You can switch between accounts and model providers within an agent, and its conversation and context persists.

one_liner.before: Work with agents that already know you

long_description.before:
We build verifiable reinforcement-learning environments, evaluations, and proprietary training datasets to improve frontier AI models and robot policies.

We focus on complex, underexplored domains like PCB and chip design, embedded systems, robotics, and specialized coding environments, where high-quality training data is scarce and existing models fall short.

Our long-term goal is to develop self-improving training infrastructure that can autonomously generate increasingly challenging tasks, evaluate performance, and continuously advance model capabilities toward recursive self-improvement.

long_description.before:
We use AI and quantum-based simulations to discover and develop new materials for defense and dual-use applications, from energetics and propellants to carbon fibers, polymers, coatings and composites. Developing a new material today takes 10+ years of trial-and-error lab work. We compress that to months, using physics-based simulation, machine learning and AI agents that only send labs candidates that can actually be made.

Sam, Ofir and Maor have spent the past two years researching the discovery of these exact materials together at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies. Together we bring deep expertise in chemical engineering, computational chemistry and AI, and the production systems to put them to work. ChemPilot spun out of that work.

The defense and dual-use industrial base runs on materials with fragile, sole-source and often adversarial supply chains, from energetics and propellants to carbon fibers, high-temperature composites and specialty polymers. Demand for new capabilities is surging, and materials take decades to develop. The West needs new materials it can make securely, fast and cheap - ChemPilot will help find and develop them.
long_description.after:
ChemPilot accelerates the discovery and development of next generation defense materials using AI and data from our automated wet lab. Developing a new material today takes 10+ years of trial and error. We compress that to months by screening for what can actually be made, then closing the loop: every lab result feeds back into the models so the next round is faster and smarter.

Sam, Ofir and Maor spent two years researching these materials at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies. Together we bring chemical engineering, computational chemistry and AI, plus the production systems to put them to work. ChemPilot spun out of that research.

The West’s defense and dual-use industrial base runs on materials with fragile, sole-source and often adversarial supply chains. Demand for new capability is surging, and materials still take decades to develop. We’re building a new kind of chemical prime: one that can discover, develop and ultimately manufacture the materials the West needs, securely, fast and at cost.

long_description.before:
OpenCrawl lets agents search over hard-to-find multimodal data.
Agents describe the data they need; OpenCrawl finds the sources, then builds and hosts custom crawlers, processing and search indexes. Each index is tuned to be the fastest, most accurate search over that data. Developers wire it into their products through MCP, CLI or API. Teams use it to find answers across their own files, tools and legacy systems.

long_description.after:
Asim is building standardized benchmarks for physical intelligence, helping robotics companies understand their robots’ capabilities and safety limits before deployment.
We test real robots under changing physical conditions, varying shape, weight, friction and material, to identify where performance breaks down and give engineers actionable feedback.

Our four founders include three PhD researchers, two specializing in robotics, with backgrounds at Sony and NASA JPL and two RoboCup@Home championship wins.

Our ambition is to become the standard robotics teams use to measure progress and assess readiness for deployment.

long_description.before:
Volaren is an agent for your portfolio that explains each move, suggests your next idea, and trades it for you. 

Connect your bank accounts & brokerage and Volaren tells you what changed and why, answers any question about your money, and turns any idea into a trade. You can copy the moves of famous investors, politicians, proven strategies and themed baskets in a tap, or set up your own AI agents to watch the market and act within the limits you choose. 

Everything works from the app, the web or a simple text, so managing your money feels like texting a portfolio manager who never sleeps.
